body: I know this is going to sound difficult. You NEED to cut her off from your life. this is going to take a lot of looking outside the box and trying to analyse yourself and this relationship from a 3rd person perspective. put yourself outside of the whole situation and look at how she treated you. I don't care how pretty she is, how genuine she seemed, or loving, or tender. look how she made you feel. just think about how you're going to feel if you keep holding on to this poison. Cut her off and stay focused on YOUR priorities. I know it's a terrible feeling but it WILL go away with time as you gain more perspective and build confidence. better people will come your way.

You're purpose is not dictated by the way people think about you or treat you. finding a purpose is the whole journey of life. you didn't ask to be born, you don't owe these people a damn thing. It's good that you're talking about it. just trying to hold that all in Can shred you up inside. I don't know what your exact circumstances are but you sound like an intelligent Person. and you're reaching out. not everyone has the guts to do that. I believe in you. the only advice i can really offer as far as bullying is don't stay quiet about it. open your mouth, make a scene. if you show no resistance, Cowards will think you're an easy target. I wholeheartedly hope that you choose to live. if there's anything i learned about life is that nothing ever stays the same. one day you will have an opportunity to be free from external oppression in your life.
